subject: Copywriting
title: Dan Wieden: Just Do It
description: A quick win: understand Dan Wieden: Just Do It.

hook.text: Dan Wieden created 'Just Do It' for Nike in 1988. Inspired partly by a murderer's last words: 'Let's do it.'

buildup.text: Wieden and Kennedy founded their agency in Portland, far from Madison Avenue. Distance bred originality.

discovery.text: The three-word slogan transcended shoes. It became a life philosophy. Nike's brand became bigger than its products.

twist.text: Wieden nearly didn't present it. He thought it was too simple. Nike's Phil Knight was lukewarm at first too.

climax.text: It ran for 35+ years across every medium. 'Just Do It' became the most recognized slogan in commercial history.

punchline.text: Three words, 35 years. Simplicity wins every time.
